eventDetail.scope: The International Conference on Asian Language Processing (IALP) is the flagship conference of the Chinese and Oriental Languages Information Processing Society (COLIPS). The conference aims to advance the science and technology of all the aspects of Asian Language Processing by providing a forum for researchers in the different fields of language study to meet. The topics of the conference covers Natural Language Processing, Spoken Language Processing, Computational Linguistics, Language Education, etc.
